title: Vitess: graceful shard failover (PlannedReparentShard) + RTO
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster vitess`: PlannedReparentShard on the first shard to a healthy replica, measures the RTO until the new primary is authoritative in the shard record, confirms the old primary demoted to REPLICA in place. --target picks a shard or tablet node.

observe.what: original primary -80/<tabletA> -> new primary -80/<tabletB>; RTO timeline; recovery=recovered. Live: ~0.17s.

observe.where: ssh control: sudo nexus-vtctldclient GetShard commerce/-80
observe.what: primary_alias.uid is the promoted tablet; old primary is now a REPLICA

whatProves: VitessAdapter.FailoverAsync runs a graceful PlannedReparentShard on the targeted shard via nexus-vtctldclient and measures the RTO to the GetShard primary_alias change; other shards are unaffected.
